statement: Verification is evidence, not a support guarantee.
rule: A render backend verifies tuples only when the whole nightly matrix passed on it in this record: every expected cell that runs the backend passed on it, and every boundary probe and every negative case behaved as expected. Each tuple then lists every backend it is verified on; backends are never inferred from each other.

environment.os: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (container in a Firecracker microVM)
environment.cpu: 4 vCPU Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 15 GiB RAM
environment.gpu: none: no GPU device in the machine (/dev/dri absent); every backend renders in software

backends.webgl: WebGL 2.0 through ANGLE on SwiftShader: 'ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (Subzero) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver)'; flags --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader
backends.webgpu: Dawn on SwiftShader's Vulkan device: adapter vendor 'google', architecture 'swiftshader', isFallbackAdapter true (a software fallback adapter); flags as WebGL plus --enable-unsafe-webgpu --enable-features=Vulkan --use-vulkan=swiftshader --use-webgpu-adapter=swiftshader. Without those flags headless Chromium exposes navigator.gpu (secure contexts) but requestAdapter() returns null

commands: node design/compatibility/cells/run-cells.mjs run --tier nightly --patches all --cell <a third of the cells> --no-cache --work <work> --tarballs <work>/tarballs   (three shards in parallel)
notes: Tier: nightly with `--patches all` (184 cells: every React adapter at its minimum and latest audited patch x the newest audited patch of every Pixi 8 minor and pixi.js 7.4.2 and 7.4.3), a superset of the scheduled nightly's 115 cells. Render backends: WebGL and WebGPU (`adapterMatrix.tiers.nightly.renderers`); Pixi 7 cells WebGL only.

Fresh: a new work directory, packages rebuilt with `pnpm build --force`, tarballs packed from that build, `--no-cache` (no verdict reused), CI=true. The npm download cache was shared (registry tarballs are integrity-checked).
Three cell shards ran in parallel on 4 vCPUs with the probes, then the negative cases and the data-only probes. No test timed out and no failure was retried.

Commits after this one change documentation, generated tables, the verification tooling and comments only; `node design/compatibility/verification.mjs compare --date 2026-10-10 --tarballs <fresh pack>` shows whether a later commit packs the same code (Markdown aside).

dataOnly.statement: Data only, not verified: these results are never verification, never enter verifiedRanges and never change a peer range.
dataOnly.description: Data-only probes (issue 17). Each probe installs the packed adapters beside a React or pixi.js the adapter does not declare, ignoring peers, and records what every cell command does. The adapters' environment checks are bypassed in the conformance run only (cell.json dataOnly.bypassEnvironmentCheck), so the suite shows what would happen past them. Results are data, never verification: nothing here enters verifiedRanges or changes a peer range.
